arabic text:
Baazar ke manzar ko, aur apne khule
sar ko bhuli nahi mai 
Apne bandhe haatho ko, bimaarke
zewarko bhuli nahi mai......
english translation text:
I have not forgotten the marketplace, nor my uncovered
head 
I have not forgotten my bound hands, nor the ornaments
of the ailing Imam...

arabic text:
Uthti hui aandhi ko, mehshat ko
bayaabako
Chupte huwe suraj ko, taariki ko
maydaako
Chalte huwe khanjar ko
Neze pe tere sar ko, Bhuli…..
english translation text:
I have not forgotten the rising storm, the terror
and the wilderness,
the setting sun, the darkness
of the battlefield,
the moving dagger,
nor your head upon the spear...

arabic text:
Ek chand tha badlime, chupta tha
nikal ta tha
Parda dare khayma ka, uthta kabhi
girta tha
Wo khaimaa e laila se
Haye rukhsate Akbar ko, Bhuli........
english translation text:
I have not forgotten the moon hidden in the clouds,
appearing and disappearing,
the curtain at the tent door,
rising and falling,
nor from Layla's tent
the farewell of Akbar...

arabic text:
Yaad ata hai dulhan ko, ghash kis
tarha aye the
Ik gathri shahe wala, jab kandho pe
laye the
Is lash ki gathri ko
Us khun bhari chadar ko, Bhuli ……
english translation text:
I remember how the bride fainted
in grief,
when the exalted King brought upon his shoulders
a bundle,
that bundle containing the body,
and that blood-soaked sheet...

arabic text:
Fizza ko mera bhayi, maa kehke bula
ta tha,
Gham uska mere bhayi, ye naam pe
jataa tha
khutbe jo maa ban kar
Ayi ti thi madar ko, Bhuli ……
english translation text:
Fizza, whom my brother called
mother,
would let the grief of my brother overcome
that name;
I have not forgotten how, like a mother,
she came to the lady during the sermons...

arabic text:
Lehrate huwe neza, aur shimr ka wo
barna
Aa aake mere peeche, har bibi ka wo
chupna
Sholo me gire gharko
Chinti huwi chaader ko, Bhuli.......
english translation text:
I have not forgotten the swaying spears
and Shimr's threats,
every lady coming to hide
behind me,
the home fallen into flames,
nor the chadar being snatched...

arabic text:
Yaad ata hai ek maa ka, wo khaak me
dhas jana
Aur aag ke sholo me, wo maa ka julas
jana
Jalte huwe julese
Lipti huwi madar ko, Bhuli.......
english translation text:
I remember the mother sinking
into the dust,
and the mother being scorched
within the flames,
clinging to the burning cradle
of her child...

arabic text:
Jis raat mai tanhaa thi, us raat ke
dhalne ko
Tute huwe neze ko, us raat ke pehre
ko
Bacho ke sisakne ko
Aur raakh ke bistar ko, Bhuli.......
english translation text:
I have not forgotten that lonely night,
nor its slow passing,
the broken spear used
as a night watch,
the sobbing children,
nor the bed of ashes...

arabic text:
Un sham ki galiyo ko, din se khule
sar guzre
Kis dar se guzar ne me, ye tola pehen
guzre
Darbare ke us dar ko
Aur shamiyo ke shar ko, Bhuli ……
english translation text:
I have not forgotten the streets of Shaam, crossed
bareheaded in daylight,
nor each doorway passed while wearing
iron collars,
the entrance of that court,
nor the evil of the people of Shaam...

arabic text:
Hai aaj bhi wo giryaa, Hai aaj bhi wo
zaari
Hai aaj bhi pathar ke, Sinese se lahu
jaari
Rote huwe pathar ko
Pathar pe rakhe sarko, Bhuli ……
english translation text:
Even today there is that weeping,
even today that lamentation;
even today blood flows
from the breast of the stones.
I have not forgotten the weeping stones,
nor the heads placed upon them...

arabic text:
Ati hai Naveed ab bhi, awaaz ye
zainab ki
Hay mujko kasam saddiyo, se sukhe
huwe lab ki
Pyaase ali asghar ko
Sukhe huwe sagar ko, Bhuli ……
english translation text:
"Naveed", even today Zainab's voice
can be heard:
By those lips that remained dry
for centuries,
I have not forgotten thirsty Ali Asghar,
nor the empty cup...
